Name: Lisa Garcia, Land Bank
Title: RESOLUTION APPROVING THE APPOINTMENT BY THE MAYOR OF LINDA GARCIA AS A MEMBER OF THE NEW YORK CITY LAND BANK.
BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

History.Description: This Resolution was Approved by Committee
History.BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

Text:
RESOLVED, Pursuant to Local Law 56 of 2026, the Council hereby approves the appointment by the Mayor of Linda Garcia as a member of the New York City Land Bank to serve a four-year term that will expire on September 9, 2030.

COUPLED ON GO
